inputs.text: Vertical medium close shot of the same adult Chinese woman at the desk, frozen in surprise while looking at a smartphone showing a second incoming-call card with blank clean space reserved for later 110 graphics. Her right index finger has pulled away from the transfer area and her shoulders stop moving. Same oval face, low ponytail, light blue shirt, dark charcoal blazer and thin silver necklace. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll, fine textile fibers, cinematic split-light transition from cold blue on one side to faint warm light on the other, suspenseful but readable composition, no generated text, no logo, no watermark.
